text:
The weariness, the immense
weariness of repeated days.
(All joy presupposes
some heroism.)
Admirable enemy,
I am born of you, suffering.
(To burn: thus I deceive myself
with an illuminated soul.)
And I live from the death
you give me smiling,
and die in the sweetness
of your vague silence.
Beloved, my beloved,
high flame in time,
you create melodies
with pauses and secrets.
And suddenly tedium stretches
into sweet forms,
and days take their names
from a feeling.

translation.title: The Weariness, the Immense...
